slo_context.purpose: To ensure the reliability and quality of financial data for accurate reporting.

data_freshness_slo.reasoning: To ensure the dashboard displays data from the most recent pipeline run.
data_freshness_slo.breach_impact: Stale data may lead to incorrect financial reports.

quality_threshold_slo.reasoning: To maintain high data quality for accurate financial analysis.
quality_threshold_slo.breach_impact: Low-quality data can result in erroneous financial insights.

row_count_slo.reasoning: To account for variability in daily transaction volumes while ensuring data completeness.

pipeline_runtime_slo.reasoning: To allow sufficient time for data processing before the morning dashboard update.
pipeline_runtime_slo.breach_impact: Exceeding runtime may delay the dashboard update, impacting timely financial reporting.
